entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
By the oath of the night, when it covers (the light).
And by the day, when it brightens.
And by the One Who created male and female.
Indeed, your efforts differ (in aims and purposes).
So, the one who gave (in the path of Allah) and practised piety.
And believed the best thing (i.e. Islam) to be true.
So, very soon We will provide him with ease.
And the one who was miserly and became careless (of the Hereafter).
And belied the best thing (i.e. Islam).
So, very soon We will subject him to the hardship (of Hell).
His wealth will not benefit him when he will fall into destruction.
Indeed, guiding is Our responsibility.
And indeed, only We are the Owner of both the Hereafter and this world.
I henceforth warned you of the Fire that is ablaze.
No one except the most unfortunate will enter it.
Who belied and turned away.
And very soon he will be kept far away from it (i.e. Hell) the one who is most pious.
Who gives his wealth in order to become pure.
And no one has done a (worldly) favour to him, for which recompense may be given in return.
He desires only the contentment of his Lord Who is the Most High.
And indeed, soon he will be very pleased.
